Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"compact_tables\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
